summary: Powell County, MT lookout on the Flathead NF: an L-4 cab is listed for 1930, a cabin for 1947, abandoned 1961, and now gone or removed.

facts.design: L-4 cab listed for 1930; cabin listed for 1947
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1961 and listed as gone or removed; no source describes what remains.

evidence.supports: about 22 miles north of Seeley Lake
lookout listed as removed (status line under its forest and township entry)
evidence.quote: LENA PEAK Flathead National Forest 20N-15W-14 Removed

notes_for_editor: Thin record: three short listings, with no staffing, no fire history and no present-day description. firelookout.com lists an L-4 cab for 1930, yet the association list classes the site as ground; the sources do not say whether the 1930 cab stood on a tower. A text search of the Flathead National Forest history (Trails of the Past) found no mention of Lena Peak. Record matches the sources on status, agency, county and coordinates; no corrections proposed.
